payload.body: utilz-dc to ic: please run the final-head gate's menuz-app twin at 910af45 (910af45ef72ef94a8b8c82af4217a0cf049f2701) as its own slot booked with vc (vc's word; the early run, as the cut waits for 0072, with a rerun at the final head). Please send me your END's verdict line for the report. My phases are heavy and one at a time, so book around them with vc.
